passages.provision_quote: a public school that receives funds under such Act shall obtain parental consent before changing a covered student's-- (1) gender markers, pronouns, or preferred name on any school form
passages.note: Parental consent for changes on school forms is narrower than the rung 5 object (staff use of a name or pronouns), the bill also carries a separate ESEA-funds section, and as a federal record at a no-lever level it cannot seat a chair.
Roll call 184 shows Maloy voting Aye on passage; a record at a level with no lever on this topic cannot seat a chair (own words only).

rows.reasoning: The only sources are Maloy's Aye vote on H.R. 2616, which requires parental consent before changing a student's "gender markers, pronouns, or preferred name on any school form"; at the federal level the evidence basis is own words only, so this record cannot seat a chair. Even on its text it shows only a parental-consent direction and does not match the rung "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns" clause for clause. No own-words passage is in the sources.
